list.title: All Accounts
list.intro: OAuth cards surface email, plan label, and observed primary or secondary usage and window reset times.

detail.title: Account detail
detail.subtitle: Inspect account metadata, confirm the credential mode, and export a Codex-compatible auth.json for OAuth rows without opening the token payload in the UI.
detail.invalidIdDetail: The route parameter is not a positive integer, so the detail query was not sent.
detail.deleteHint: Deletes this account from admin lists and removes it from routing or Playground eligibility.
detail.modelsEmpty: No models configured. Models can be added manually or refreshed from upstream.
detail.proxyHint: When enabled, this account dials upstreams through the global proxy configured in Settings. If that proxy is later removed, requests for this account fail fast instead of silently going direct. When disabled, egress is always direct.
detail.proxySetFailed: Failed to update the outbound proxy switch

detailEdit.panelHint: Update the nickname, rotate the API key, change the endpoint override, or adjust capabilities. OAuth accounts cannot be edited here.

hints.name: 1-64 characters.
hints.apiKey: Leave blank to keep the current key. 1-256 characters if set.
hints.baseURL: Optional OpenAI-compatible endpoint override. Leave empty to clear.
hints.capabilities: API operations this account can handle. Leave empty for none.

validation.nameMax: name must be at most 64 characters
validation.baseURLShape: base_url must be an absolute http(s) URL without query or fragment

picker.intro: Choose how to connect this router to LLM. Use browser sign-in locally, or device code when the router runs on a server.

oauthBrowser.title: Codex browser sign-in
oauthBrowser.detail: Sign in with your ChatGPT subscription in this browser.

oauthDevice.title: Codex Device Code
oauthDevice.detail: Sign in from another device when this server cannot complete browser sign-in.

oauthImport.title: Import Codex auth.json
oauthImport.detail: Import an existing Codex auth.json file from a local client.

newApiKey.intro: Paste an OpenAI API key to create a new upstream account. The key is stored and used for routing requests to the OpenAI-compatible API.

hints.name: 1-64 characters.
hints.apiKey: 1-256 characters. Stored verbatim in upstream_accounts; encryption-at-rest is deferred to the key-vault plugin.
hints.baseURL: Optional OpenAI-compatible endpoint override. Leave empty for the default.

validation.nameMax: name must be at most 64 characters
validation.baseURLShape: base_url must be an absolute http(s) URL without query or fragment
validation.missingAccountID: create account response missing account id

newImport.intro: The router accepts a Codex-compatible auth.json file or pasted JSON text, derives the account metadata from the embedded ID token, and creates an oauth_import row without rendering token bytes in the UI.

hints.file: Select a Codex-compatible auth.json file from your local machine. The browser reads the file locally and submits the raw JSON text.
hints.paste: Paste the complete Codex-compatible auth.json content. The browser sends it as JSON text; token bytes are never rendered after submission.

validation.fileRequired: Choose an auth.json file before importing.

newOauth.intro: Open a ChatGPT sign-in tab. If the browser cannot return to this router, paste the localhost callback URL below.

browserActions.label: Browser tab
browserActions.hint: Open the ChatGPT sign-in tab now. If your browser blocked the popup, reopen it from here.

callback.label: Paste callback URL
callback.hint: Paste the full localhost callback URL from your browser address bar. The raw URL stays hidden by default.

flow.label: Pending flow
flow.hint: One OAuth flow may be active per router instance.

flowStatus.label: Flow status
flowStatus.hint: Automatic callback and manual paste are both accepted for this browser flow.

status.browserMethodDetail: The router opens one sign-in flow and accepts whichever callback rail finishes first.

validation.callbackRequired: Paste the callback URL to continue.

err.oauth_flow_in_progress: A flow is already pending — finish or cancel it first.
err.oauth_state_mismatch: State mismatch — paste the latest callback URL from the active sign-in tab.
err.invalid_callback_url: The pasted callback URL is not valid for this flow.
err.no_flow_in_progress: No OAuth flow is pending — start a new browser sign-in first.
err.oauth_invalid_grant: OpenAI rejected the authorization code for this flow.
err.oauth_internal_error: The router hit an internal OAuth error.
err.oauth_store_failed: The router could not persist the OAuth account.
err.transport_error: The request did not reach the router cleanly.

callbackReason.url_prefix_mismatch: The callback URL must start with http://localhost:1455-1458/auth/callback.
callbackReason.missing_code_and_error: The callback URL is missing both code and error query parameters.

conflict.detail: Only one OAuth flow may be active per router instance. Cancel the pending flow before starting a new browser sign-in.

terminal.defaultTitle: The flow ended with an error.
terminal.defaultDetail: Review the provider error, then start a fresh browser sign-in. The callback input stays hidden after a terminal error.
terminal.restartHint: Restart from a clean flow. The router never reuses an already-consumed callback URL.

toasts.popupBlocked: The sign-in tab was blocked by the browser. Use "Open sign-in tab again" to retry.
toasts.flowCancelled: Flow cancelled — start again when you are ready.

newOauthDevice.intro: Use this when localhost callback is unavailable. Open the verification page, enter the device code, and this page will continue automatically after approval.

userCode.label: Device code
userCode.hint: Enter this code on the verification page.

verificationURL.label: Open verification page
verificationURL.hint: Use the provider page to approve this router session.

flow.label: Pending flow
flow.hint: Only one OAuth flow may be active per router instance. Cancelling clears the current in-memory slot.

err.oauth_flow_in_progress: A flow is already pending — finish or cancel it first.
err.device_auth_unavailable: This account cannot use the device flow — try browser sign-in instead.
err.invalid_oauth_provider: The requested OAuth provider is not available for this route.
err.oauth_internal_error: The router hit an internal OAuth error.
err.oauth_store_failed: The router could not persist the OAuth account.
err.transport_error: The request did not reach the router cleanly.

toasts.flowExpired: Flow expired — start again when you are ready.
